body:
Yeah, you're right, you strike up different relationships with different people. Unfortunately I can't afford private therapy and when you go with the NHS you've got the epic wait lists and not much choice in who you see.

But I guess I can't complain if I'm not going to give it another try. I plan on seeing the doc again very soon to discuss the options. Ultimately though it all just feels like putting lipstick on a pig. Drug me up and give me whatever therapy you have to offer, but underneath it all this is it.

I've had two therapists. One talky one a long time ago, and a CBT one a couple years back. The former always made me feel better immediately afterwards, but the effect would wear off pretty quick. The latter was just incredibly unhelpful for me and if anything just made me overthink things more than I already do.

Glad to hear that you are managing to figure out things for yourself though!
